heroHeadline: Day 658: FGR Requests US Evidence Package; Inzunza Stays in Senate; Mayito Flaco–Zetas Alliance Reported
heroSubtitle: 658 days of cartel civil war — May 12: Mexico's FGR advanced its formal evidentiary review, with the Attorney General's office intending to request the complete evidence package from Washington after ruling US documentation for the Rocha Moya indictment insufficient under Mexican law. Senator Inzunza Cázares (one of 10 indicted MORENA officials) publicly vowed to continue serving in the Senate while fighting the charges — 13 days after the historic SDNY indictment with no extradition in sight. Intelligence reporting indicates Ismael 'Mayito Flaco' Zambada Sicairos reached a reported deal with Zetas-affiliated groups to counterbalance the Chapitos-CJNG alliance, potentially cementing La Mayiza's ~90% territorial dominance in Sinaloa. USMCA's mandatory June 2026 review remains Washington's strongest trade leverage. Running conflict toll: ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024; March 2026 marked the lowest monthly count (79–121) since the war began.
